```{r load library}
# ============================================
# 0) SETUP & LIBRARY
# ============================================
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(readr)
library(tibble)

START <- as.Date("2017-01-01") 
END   <- as.Date("2025-12-31")

p_gold <- "C:/Users/IFA/Downloads/skripsii/skripsi/antam_price2.csv"
p_btc  <- "C:/Users/IFA/Downloads/skripsii/skripsi/Data Historis Bitcoinn.csv"
p_ihsg <- "C:/Users/IFA/Downloads/skripsii/skripsi/ihsg_daily.csv"
p_kurs <- "C:/Users/IFA/Downloads/skripsii/skripsi/kurs_transaksi_bi_usd_2017-01-01_2025-12-31.csv"

clip_range <- function(df) {
  df %>% filter(Date >= START, Date <= END)
}
```

# LOAD DATA
 
```{r}
# ============================================
# 1) LOAD DATA HARGA: GOLD, BTC, IHSG
# ============================================

# a) GOLD 
gold <- fread(p_gold, sep = ";", encoding = "UTF-8")
if (!all(c("Date","Price") %in% names(gold))) {
  gold <- fread(p_gold, sep = ",", encoding = "UTF-8")
}
stopifnot(all(c("Date","Price") %in% names(gold)))

gold <- gold %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(Date),
    gold = as.numeric(Price)
  ) %>%
  select(Date, gold) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date), !is.na(gold)) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  clip_range()

# b) BTC 
btc <- fread(p_btc, sep = ";", encoding = "UTF-8")
stopifnot(all(c("Tanggal","Terakhir") %in% names(btc)))

btc <- btc %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(Tanggal),
    btc_usd = readr::parse_number(
      as.character(Terakhir),
      locale = readr::locale(decimal_mark = ",", grouping_mark = ".")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Date, btc_usd) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date),  !is.na(btc_usd)) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  clip_range()

# c) IHSG 
ihsg <- fread(p_ihsg, sep = ",", encoding = "UTF-8")

stopifnot(all(c("Date","ihsg") %in% names(ihsg)))

ihsg <- ihsg %>%
  mutate(
    Date = ymd(Date),
    ihsg = as.numeric(ihsg)
  ) %>%
  select(Date, ihsg) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date),!is.na(ihsg) ) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  clip_range()

 #d) kurs
kurs <- fread(p_kurs, sep = ";", encoding = "UTF-8")
setnames(kurs, tolower(names(kurs)))
stopifnot(all(c("tanggal","kurs_jual","kurs_beli") %in% names(kurs)))

kurs <- kurs %>%
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(tanggal),
    kurs_jual = as.numeric(kurs_jual)/100,
    kurs_beli = as.numeric(kurs_beli)/100,
    USDIDR = (kurs_jual + kurs_beli) / 2,
    IDRUSD = 1 / USDIDR
  ) %>%
  select(Date, USDIDR, IDRUSD) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date), !is.na(USDIDR), !is.na(IDRUSD)) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  distinct(Date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  clip_range()
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 2) MERGE REAL OVERLAP ONLY
# ============================================
#conver kurs dan harga btc usd
df_level <- gold %>% #memastikan setiap variabel terdapat nilainya, apabila tidak ada maka tidak dipakai
  inner_join(btc,  by = "Date") %>%
  inner_join(ihsg, by = "Date") %>%
  inner_join(kurs, by = "Date") %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(
    btc = btc_usd * USDIDR
  ) %>%
  select(Date, ihsg, gold, btc, USDIDR, IDRUSD)

cat("=== DATA LEVEL SETELAH MERGE ===\n")
cat("Rentang tanggal:", as.character(min(df_level$Date)), "→", as.character(max(df_level$Date)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(df_level), "\n")
cat("Duplikat Date:", sum(duplicated(df_level$Date)), "\n")
cat("Missing values:\n")
print(sapply(df_level, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 2A) EDA SEBELUM PREPROCESSING
#    Data level hasil merge
# ============================================

library(e1071)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)

cat("\n=== EDA SEBELUM PREPROCESSING ===\n")

# Pastikan Date bertipe Date
df_level <- df_level %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

cat("Rentang tanggal:", as.character(min(df_level$Date, na.rm = TRUE)), 
    "→", as.character(max(df_level$Date, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(df_level), "\n")
cat("Duplikat Date:", sum(duplicated(df_level$Date)), "\n")

cat("Missing values:\n")
print(sapply(df_level, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

# ============================================
# STATISTIKA DESKRIPTIF DATA LEVEL
# ============================================

var_all <- c("ihsg", "gold", "btc", "USDIDR")
var_all <- var_all[var_all %in% names(df_level)]

var_labels_all <- c(
  ihsg   = "IHSG",
  gold   = "Emas",
  btc    = "Bitcoin",
  USDIDR = "USD/IDR"
)

desc_level <- bind_rows(lapply(var_all, function(v) {
  x <- df_level[[v]]
  
  data.frame(
    Variable     = var_labels_all[[v]],
    Mean         = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median       = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Std_Dev      = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min          = min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max          = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    Skewness     = e1071::skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
    Kurtosis     = e1071::kurtosis(x, na.rm = TRUE, type = 2),
    Observations = sum(!is.na(x))
  )
}))

cat("\n=== STATISTIKA DESKRIPTIF DATA LEVEL ===\n")
print(desc_level)

# ============================================
# DATA LONG UNTUK VISUALISASI
# Visualisasi hanya IHSG, Emas, dan Bitcoin
# ============================================

var_plot <- c("ihsg", "gold", "btc")

var_labels_plot <- c(
  ihsg = "IHSG",
  gold = "Emas",
  btc  = "Bitcoin"
)

df_level_long <- df_level %>%
  select(Date, all_of(var_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Date,
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = recode(Variable, !!!var_labels_plot),
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin"))
  )

# ============================================
# WARNA SETIAP ASET
# ============================================

asset_cols <- c(
  "IHSG"    = "#2F5597",
  "Emas"    = "#C9A227",
  "Bitcoin" = "#F28E2B"
)

# ============================================
# TEMA GRAFIK UNTUK SKRIPSI A4
# ============================================

theme_eda <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.35, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# ============================================
# 1) LINE CHART DATA LEVEL
# ============================================

p_level_line <- ggplot(df_level_long, aes(x = Date, y = Value, color = Variable)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      big.mark = ".",
      decimal.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tahun",
    y = "Nilai Data Asli"
  ) +
  theme_eda

print(p_level_line)

# ============================================
# 2) BOXPLOT DATA LEVEL
# ============================================

p_level_box <- ggplot(df_level_long, aes(x = Variable, y = Value, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.85,
    outlier.size = 0.7,
    outlier.alpha = 0.45
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      big.mark = ".",
      decimal.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Nilai Data Asli"
  ) +
  theme_eda +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_level_box)

# ============================================
# 3) HISTOGRAM DATA LEVEL
# ============================================

p_level_hist <- ggplot(df_level_long, aes(x = Value, fill = Variable)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      big.mark = ".",
      decimal.mark = ",",
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Nilai Data Asli",
    y = "Frekuensi"
  ) +
  theme_eda

print(p_level_hist)

# ============================================
# KORELASI DATA LEVEL
# ============================================

cor_level <- df_level %>%
  select(all_of(var_all)) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")

cat("\n=== KORELASI DATA LEVEL SEBELUM PREPROCESSING ===\n")
print(round(cor_level, 4))

# ============================================
# SIMPAN OUTPUT VISUALISASI KE PNG
# Ukuran disesuaikan untuk dokumen A4
# ============================================

getwd()

out_dir <- "output_visual_eda"

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir)
}

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "line_chart_data_level.png"),
  plot = p_level_line,
  width = 13,
  height = 14,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# Boxplot: lebih pendek karena hanya satu baris panel
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "boxplot_data_level.png"),
  plot = p_level_box,
  width = 13,
  height = 7,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

# Histogram: tinggi sedang agar panel tetap terbaca
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "histogram_data_level.png"),
  plot = p_level_hist,
  width = 13,
  height = 14,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

cat("\n=== FILE PNG BERHASIL DISIMPAN DI FOLDER: ", out_dir, " ===\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 3) REINDEX KE BUSINESS DAYS (SENIN-JUMAT)
# ============================================

all_days <- seq(from = START, to = END, by = "day")
idxB <- all_days[!wday(all_days) %in% c(1, 7)]   # 1=Sunday, 7=Saturday

dfB <- tibble(Date = idxB) %>%
  left_join(df_level, by = "Date") %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\n=== SETELAH REINDEX BUSINESS DAYS ===\n")
cat("Rentang tanggal:", as.character(min(dfB$Date)), "→", as.character(max(dfB$Date)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(dfB), "\n")
cat("Missing awal:\n")
print(sapply(dfB[, c("ihsg","gold","btc","USDIDR","IDRUSD")], function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

# ============================================
# 4) IMPUTASI: HANYA FORWARD FILL
#    TANPA INTERPOLASI LINEAR
# ============================================

df_imp <- dfB

# forward fill untuk semua seri
for (cc in c("ihsg","gold","btc","USDIDR","IDRUSD")) {
  df_imp[[cc]] <- zoo::na.locf(df_imp[[cc]], na.rm = FALSE)
}

# recalculate IDRUSD dari USDIDR supaya konsisten
df_imp <- df_imp %>%
  mutate(
    IDRUSD = 1 / USDIDR
  )

# jika ada leading NA di awal, buang
df_imp <- df_imp %>%
  filter(!is.na(ihsg), !is.na(gold), !is.na(btc), !is.na(USDIDR), !is.na(IDRUSD)) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\n=== SETELAH FORWARD FILL ===\n")
cat("Rentang tanggal:", as.character(min(df_imp$Date)), "→", as.character(max(df_imp$Date)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(df_imp), "\n")
cat("Missing setelah fill:\n")
print(sapply(df_imp[, c("ihsg","gold","btc","USDIDR","IDRUSD")], function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

# ============================================
# 3) SANITASI UNTUK RETURN
# ============================================
df_imp <- df_imp %>%
  mutate(
    ihsg = as.numeric(ihsg),
    gold = as.numeric(gold),
    btc  = as.numeric(btc),
    USDIDR = as.numeric(USDIDR),
    IDRUSD = as.numeric(IDRUSD)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    ihsg > 0,
    gold > 0,
    btc  > 0,
    USDIDR > 0,
    IDRUSD > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\n=== SETELAH SANITASI ===\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(df_imp), "\n")
cat("Nilai 0:\n")
print(c(
  ihsg = sum(df_imp$ihsg == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  gold = sum(df_imp$gold == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  btc  = sum(df_imp$btc  == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
))
# ============================================
# 4) HITUNG LOG-RETURN (%)
# ============================================

rets <- df_imp %>%
  mutate(
    ihsg = 100 * (log(ihsg)    - lag(log(ihsg))),
    gold = 100 * (log(gold)    - lag(log(gold))),
    btc  = 100 * (log(btc)     - lag(log(btc)))
  ) %>%
  select(Date, ihsg, gold, btc) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ihsg), !is.na(gold), !is.na(btc)) %>%
  arrange(Date)

cat("\n=== DATA RETURN FINAL ===\n")
cat("Rentang tanggal:", as.character(min(rets$Date)), "→", as.character(max(rets$Date)), "\n")
cat("Jumlah observasi:", nrow(rets), "\n")
cat("Duplikat Date:", sum(duplicated(rets$Date)), "\n")
cat("Missing values:\n")
print(sapply(rets, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

cat("\nPreview returns (5 baris):\n")
print(head(rets, 5))
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# EDA RETURN IHSG, EMAS, DAN BITCOIN
# ============================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(zoo)

# Pastikan Date bertipe Date
rets <- rets %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

# ============================================
# DATA LONG RETURN
# ============================================

rets_long <- rets %>%
  select(Date, ihsg, gold, btc) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ihsg, gold, btc),
    names_to = "Asset",
    values_to = "Return"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Asset = recode(
      Asset,
      ihsg = "IHSG",
      gold = "Emas",
      btc  = "Bitcoin"
    ),
    Asset = factor(Asset, levels = c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin"))
  )

# ============================================
# WARNA ASET
# ============================================

asset_cols <- c(
  "IHSG"    = "#2C7BB6",
  "Emas"    = "#FDB813",
  "Bitcoin" = "#F46D43"
)

theme_return <- theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.35, "lines"),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# ============================================
# 1) BOXPLOT RETURN
# ============================================

p_return_box <- ggplot(rets_long, aes(x = Asset, y = Return, fill = Asset)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.80,
    outlier.color = "red",
    outlier.size = 0.8,
    outlier.alpha = 0.55
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      decimal.mark = ",",
      big.mark = ".",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Return (%)"
  ) +
  theme_return +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

print(p_return_box)

# ============================================
# 2) LINE CHART RETURN
#    Tidak ditumpuk dalam satu panel
# ============================================

p_return_line <- ggplot(rets_long, aes(x = Date, y = Return, color = Asset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "1 year",
    date_labels = "%Y",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.08))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      decimal.mark = ",",
      big.mark = ".",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Tahun",
    y = "Return (%)"
  ) +
  theme_return

print(p_return_line)

# ============================================
# 3) HISTOGRAM RETURN + GARIS DISTRIBUSI
# ============================================

p_return_hist <- ggplot(rets_long, aes(x = Return, fill = Asset)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 50,
    color = "white",
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_density(
    aes(color = Asset),
    linewidth = 0.75,
    adjust = 1.1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = asset_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_number(
      decimal.mark = ",",
      big.mark = ".",
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Return (%)",
    y = "Kepadatan"
  ) +
  theme_return +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.25)
  )

print(p_return_hist)

# ============================================
# 4) HEATMAP KORELASI RETURN
# ============================================

cor_matrix <- rets %>%
  select(ihsg, gold, btc) %>%
  cor(use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")

rownames(cor_matrix) <- c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin")
colnames(cor_matrix) <- c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin")

cor_long <- as.data.frame(as.table(cor_matrix)) %>%
  rename(
    Asset_1 = Var1,
    Asset_2 = Var2,
    Correlation = Freq
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Correlation_show = ifelse(abs(Correlation) < 0.005, 0, Correlation),
    Label = sprintf("%.2f", Correlation_show),
    Label = gsub("\\.", ",", Label),
    TextColor = ifelse(abs(Correlation_show) >= 0.60, "white", "black"),
    Asset_1 = factor(Asset_1, levels = c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin")),
    Asset_2 = factor(Asset_2, levels = c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin"))
  )
p_return_cor <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = Asset_1, y = Asset_2, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Label, color = TextColor),
    size = 3.2,
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# (A) UNIT ROOT: ADF, KPSS, ZIVOT-ANDREWS
#     HANYA UNTUK DATA RETURN
#     DENGAN CRITICAL VALUE + P-VALUE APPROX
#     BREAK POINT HANYA UNTUK ZIVOT-ANDREWS
# ============================================

library(urca)
library(dplyr)

core_cols <- c("ihsg", "gold", "btc")

# ============================================
# FUNGSI BANTU P-VALUE APPROX
# ============================================

pvalue_approx <- function(stat, cv_1, cv_5, cv_10, test_type) {

  if (test_type %in% c("ADF", "ZA")) {

    # ADF dan ZA merupakan lower-tail test
    # Semakin negatif statistik, semakin kuat menolak H0

    if (stat <= cv_1) {
      return(0.01)

    } else if (stat >= cv_10) {
      return(0.10)

    } else {
      return(
        approx(
          x = c(cv_1, cv_5, cv_10),
          y = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10),
          xout = stat
        )$y
      )
    }
  }

  if (test_type == "KPSS") {

    # KPSS merupakan upper-tail test
    # Semakin besar statistik, semakin kuat menolak H0

    if (stat >= cv_1) {
      return(0.01)

    } else if (stat <= cv_10) {
      return(0.10)

    } else {
      return(
        approx(
          x = c(cv_10, cv_5, cv_1),
          y = c(0.10, 0.05, 0.01),
          xout = stat
        )$y
      )
    }
  }
}

pvalue_range <- function(stat, cv_1, cv_5, cv_10, test_type) {

  if (test_type %in% c("ADF", "ZA")) {

    if (stat <= cv_1) {
      return("p <= 0.01")

    } else if (stat <= cv_5) {
      return("0.01 < p <= 0.05")

    } else if (stat <= cv_10) {
      return("0.05 < p <= 0.10")

    } else {
      return("p > 0.10")
    }
  }

  if (test_type == "KPSS") {

    if (stat >= cv_1) {
      return("p <= 0.01")

    } else if (stat >= cv_5) {
      return("0.01 < p <= 0.05")

    } else if (stat >= cv_10) {
      return("0.05 < p <= 0.10")

    } else {
      return("p > 0.10")
    }
  }
}

# ============================================
# RETURN DATA
# ============================================

returns_mat <- rets %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  transmute(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    ihsg = as.numeric(ihsg),
    gold = as.numeric(gold),
    btc  = as.numeric(btc)
  )

# ============================================
# FUNCTION UNIT ROOT TEST
# ============================================

unit_root_tests <- function(
    x,
    dates,
    name = "series",
    adf_type = "drift",
    kpss_type = "mu",
    za_model = "both"
) {

  x <- as.numeric(x)
  dates <- as.Date(dates)

  # Menghapus NA pada data dan tanggal secara bersamaan
  valid_data <- complete.cases(x, dates)

  x <- x[valid_data]
  dates <- dates[valid_data]

  n <- length(x)

  cat("\n============================\n")
  cat("UNIT ROOT untuk:", name, "\n")
  cat("N =", n, "\n")
  cat("============================\n")

  k_adf <- floor((n - 1)^(1 / 3))

  hasil_ringkas <- data.frame()
  hasil_break_za <- data.frame()

  # =====================================================
  # 1. ADF TEST
  # =====================================================

  cat("\n[ADF TEST]\n")

  tryCatch({

    adf_res <- ur.df(
      y = x,
      type = adf_type,
      lags = k_adf,
      selectlags = "Fixed"
    )

    tau_name <- switch(
      adf_type,
      "none"  = "tau1",
      "drift" = "tau2",
      "trend" = "tau3"
    )

    adf_stat <- as.numeric(adf_res@teststat[1, tau_name])
    adf_cv   <- adf_res@cval[tau_name, ]

    adf_cv_1pct  <- as.numeric(adf_cv["1pct"])
    adf_cv_5pct  <- as.numeric(adf_cv["5pct"])
    adf_cv_10pct <- as.numeric(adf_cv["10pct"])

    adf_p_value <- pvalue_approx(
      stat = adf_stat,
      cv_1 = adf_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = adf_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = adf_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "ADF"
    )

    adf_p_range <- pvalue_range(
      stat = adf_stat,
      cv_1 = adf_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = adf_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = adf_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "ADF"
    )

    keputusan_adf <- ifelse(
      adf_stat <= adf_cv_5pct,
      "Tolak H0: stasioner",
      "Gagal tolak H0: mengandung unit root"
    )

    cat("ADF type          :", adf_type, "\n")
    cat("ADF statistic     :", adf_stat, "\n")
    cat("ADF p-value       :", round(adf_p_value, 4), "\n")
    cat("ADF p-value range :", adf_p_range, "\n")
    cat("ADF lag used      :", k_adf, "\n")
    cat("ADF CV 1%         :", adf_cv_1pct, "\n")
    cat("ADF CV 5%         :", adf_cv_5pct, "\n")
    cat("ADF CV 10%        :", adf_cv_10pct, "\n")
    cat("Keputusan 5%      :", keputusan_adf, "\n")

    hasil_ringkas <- rbind(
      hasil_ringkas,
      data.frame(
        Variable = name,
        Test = "ADF",
        Statistic = adf_stat,
        P_value = adf_p_value,
        P_value_range = adf_p_range,
        CV_1pct = adf_cv_1pct,
        CV_5pct = adf_cv_5pct,
        CV_10pct = adf_cv_10pct,
        Decision_5pct = keputusan_adf,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("ADF gagal:", e$message, "\n")
  })

  # =====================================================
  # 2. KPSS TEST
  # =====================================================

  cat("\n[KPSS TEST]\n")

  tryCatch({

    kpss_res <- ur.kpss(
      y = x,
      type = kpss_type,
      lags = "long"
    )

    kpss_stat <- as.numeric(kpss_res@teststat)
    kpss_cv   <- kpss_res@cval[1, ]

    kpss_cv_1pct  <- as.numeric(kpss_cv["1pct"])
    kpss_cv_5pct  <- as.numeric(kpss_cv["5pct"])
    kpss_cv_10pct <- as.numeric(kpss_cv["10pct"])

    kpss_p_value <- pvalue_approx(
      stat = kpss_stat,
      cv_1 = kpss_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = kpss_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = kpss_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "KPSS"
    )

    kpss_p_range <- pvalue_range(
      stat = kpss_stat,
      cv_1 = kpss_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = kpss_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = kpss_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "KPSS"
    )

    keputusan_kpss <- ifelse(
      kpss_stat >= kpss_cv_5pct,
      "Tolak H0: tidak stasioner",
      "Gagal tolak H0: stasioner"
    )

    cat("KPSS type          :", kpss_type, "\n")
    cat("KPSS lag type      : long\n")
    cat("KPSS statistic     :", kpss_stat, "\n")
    cat("KPSS p-value       :", round(kpss_p_value, 4), "\n")
    cat("KPSS p-value range :", kpss_p_range, "\n")
    cat("KPSS CV 1%         :", kpss_cv_1pct, "\n")
    cat("KPSS CV 5%         :", kpss_cv_5pct, "\n")
    cat("KPSS CV 10%        :", kpss_cv_10pct, "\n")
    cat("Keputusan 5%       :", keputusan_kpss, "\n")

    hasil_ringkas <- rbind(
      hasil_ringkas,
      data.frame(
        Variable = name,
        Test = "KPSS",
        Statistic = kpss_stat,
        P_value = kpss_p_value,
        P_value_range = kpss_p_range,
        CV_1pct = kpss_cv_1pct,
        CV_5pct = kpss_cv_5pct,
        CV_10pct = kpss_cv_10pct,
        Decision_5pct = keputusan_kpss,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("KPSS gagal:", e$message, "\n")
  })

  # =====================================================
  # 3. ZIVOT-ANDREWS TEST
  # =====================================================

  cat("\n[ZIVOT-ANDREWS TEST]\n")

  tryCatch({

    za_res <- ur.za(
      y = x,
      model = za_model,
      lag = k_adf
    )

    za_stat <- unname(as.numeric(za_res@teststat))
    za_cv   <- unname(as.numeric(za_res@cval))

    za_cv_1pct  <- za_cv[1]
    za_cv_5pct  <- za_cv[2]
    za_cv_10pct <- za_cv[3]

    # Break point Zivot-Andrews
    za_break_index <- as.integer(za_res@bpoint)

    za_break_date <- if (
      length(za_break_index) == 1 &&
      !is.na(za_break_index) &&
      za_break_index >= 1 &&
      za_break_index <= length(dates)
    ) {
      dates[za_break_index]
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    }

    za_break_value <- if (
      length(za_break_index) == 1 &&
      !is.na(za_break_index) &&
      za_break_index >= 1 &&
      za_break_index <= length(x)
    ) {
      x[za_break_index]
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    za_p_value <- pvalue_approx(
      stat = za_stat,
      cv_1 = za_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = za_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = za_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "ZA"
    )

    za_p_range <- pvalue_range(
      stat = za_stat,
      cv_1 = za_cv_1pct,
      cv_5 = za_cv_5pct,
      cv_10 = za_cv_10pct,
      test_type = "ZA"
    )

    keputusan_za <- ifelse(
      za_stat <= za_cv_5pct,
      "Tolak H0: stasioner dengan structural break",
      "Gagal tolak H0: mengandung unit root"
    )

    cat("ZA model          :", za_model, "\n")
    cat("ZA statistic      :", za_stat, "\n")
    cat("ZA p-value        :", round(za_p_value, 4), "\n")
    cat("ZA p-value range  :", za_p_range, "\n")
    cat("ZA lag used       :", k_adf, "\n")
    cat("ZA CV 1%          :", za_cv_1pct, "\n")
    cat("ZA CV 5%          :", za_cv_5pct, "\n")
    cat("ZA CV 10%         :", za_cv_10pct, "\n")
    cat("Break point index :", za_break_index, "\n")
    cat(
      "Break point date  :",
      ifelse(
        is.na(za_break_date),
        NA,
        format(za_break_date, "%Y-%m-%d")
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    cat("Break point value :", za_break_value, "\n")
    cat("Keputusan 5%      :", keputusan_za, "\n")

    hasil_ringkas <- rbind(
      hasil_ringkas,
      data.frame(
        Variable = name,
        Test = "Zivot-Andrews",
        Statistic = za_stat,
        P_value = za_p_value,
        P_value_range = za_p_range,
        CV_1pct = za_cv_1pct,
        CV_5pct = za_cv_5pct,
        CV_10pct = za_cv_10pct,
        Decision_5pct = keputusan_za,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )

    hasil_break_za <- data.frame(
      Variable = name,
      ZA_model = za_model,
      Break_point_index = za_break_index,
      Break_point_date = za_break_date,
      Break_point_value = za_break_value,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Zivot-Andrews gagal:", e$message, "\n")
  })

  return(
    list(
      hasil_unit_root = hasil_ringkas,
      hasil_break_za = hasil_break_za
    )
  )
}

# ============================================
# TEST RETURNS ONLY
# ============================================

cat("\n\n===== UNIT ROOT TEST: RETURNS =====\n")

hasil_unit_root <- data.frame()
hasil_breakpoint_za <- data.frame()

for (col in core_cols) {

  hasil_col <- unit_root_tests(
    x = returns_mat[[col]],
    dates = returns_mat$Date,
    name = paste(col, "return"),
    adf_type = "drift",
    kpss_type = "mu",
    za_model = "both"
  )

  hasil_unit_root <- rbind(
    hasil_unit_root,
    hasil_col$hasil_unit_root
  )

  hasil_breakpoint_za <- rbind(
    hasil_breakpoint_za,
    hasil_col$hasil_break_za
  )
}

rownames(hasil_unit_root) <- NULL
rownames(hasil_breakpoint_za) <- NULL

# ============================================
# TABEL RINGKAS HASIL UNIT ROOT
# ============================================

cat("\n\n===== TABEL RINGKAS UNIT ROOT TEST =====\n")
print(hasil_unit_root)

# ============================================
# TABEL BREAK POINT ZIVOT-ANDREWS
# ============================================

cat("\n\n===== BREAK POINT ZIVOT-ANDREWS =====\n")
print(hasil_breakpoint_za)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# UJI KAUSALITAS GRANGER
# SESUAI TEORI: PER PASANGAN VARIABEL
# ============================================
library(lmtest)

cat("\n=== UJI KAUSALITAS GRANGER ===\n")
cat("Lag yang digunakan:", p_var, "\n")

granger_result <- data.frame(
  Variabel_X = character(),
  Variabel_Y = character(),
  Lag = integer(),
  F_statistic = numeric(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  Keputusan = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

vars_name <- colnames(data_var)

for (y in vars_name) {
  for (x in vars_name) {
    if (x != y) {
      gt <- grangertest(
        as.formula(paste(y, "~", x)),
        order = p_var,
        data = data_var
      )
      
      granger_result <- rbind(
        granger_result,
        data.frame(
          Variabel_X = x,
          Variabel_Y = y,
          Lag = p_var,
          F_statistic = gt$F[2],
          P_value = gt$`Pr(>F)`[2],
          Keputusan = ifelse(gt$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.05, "Tolak H0", "Gagal Tolak H0")
        )
      )
    }
  }
}

print(granger_result)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 2. CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL RETURN: IHSG, EMAS, BITCOIN
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Data long untuk cumulative residual semua aset
cumres_all <- returns_mat %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Date) %>%
  dplyr::select(Date, ihsg, gold, btc) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Date),
    dplyr::if_all(c(ihsg, gold, btc), ~ !is.na(.) & is.finite(.))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ihsg, gold, btc),
    names_to = "Asset",
    values_to = "Return"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Asset = dplyr::recode(
      Asset,
      ihsg = "IHSG",
      gold = "Emas",
      btc  = "Bitcoin"
    ),
    Asset = factor(Asset, levels = c("IHSG", "Emas", "Bitcoin"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Asset) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mean_return = mean(Return, na.rm = TRUE),
    resid_mu = Return - mean_return,
    S_t = cumsum(resid_mu),
    S_t_sq = S_t^2,
    kontribusi_S = S_t_sq / sum(S_t_sq, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# ============================================================
# RINGKASAN CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL PER ASET
# ============================================================

summary_cumres_all <- cumres_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Asset) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Min_S_t = min(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1_S_t = quantile(S_t, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_S_t = median(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_S_t = mean(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3_S_t = quantile(S_t, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_S_t = max(S_t, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_Abs_S_t = max(abs(S_t), na.rm = TRUE),
    Sum_S_t_Square = sum(S_t_sq, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("\n=== RINGKASAN CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL IHSG, EMAS, BITCOIN ===\n")
print(summary_cumres_all)

# ============================================================
# 15 TANGGAL KONTRIBUSI CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL TERBESAR PER ASET
# ============================================================

top_cumres_all <- cumres_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Asset) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(kontribusi_S), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(Asset, Date, Return, resid_mu, S_t, kontribusi_S)

cat("\n=== 15 TANGGAL KONTRIBUSI CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL TERBESAR PER ASET ===\n")
print(top_cumres_all)

# ============================================================
# GRAFIK PEMBANDING CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL
# ============================================================

p_cumres_all <- ggplot(cumres_all, aes(x = Date, y = S_t)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~Asset, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Tanggal",
    y = "Cumulative Residual",
    title = "Perbandingan Cumulative Residual Return"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_cumres_all)

# ============================================================
#CUMULATIVE RESIDUAL DALAM SATU PANEL
# ============================================================

p_cumres_overlay <- ggplot(cumres_all, aes(x = Date, y = S_t, color = Asset)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.35, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    x = "Tanggal",
    y = "Cumulative Residual",
    color = "Aset",
    title = "Overlay Cumulative Residual Return"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(p_cumres_overlay)
```
